reddit.content:
I built OnlyIdeas around a small reading problem: the paper is in one window, a translation is in another, and the question about a particular sentence has disappeared into a chat history.

The reader keeps the original, translated or interlaced passages together with equations and figures. You can ask about a selected passage and save papers for offline reading. I’ve just shipped the Mac app for Intel and Apple silicon; it’s free to download.

PDF conversion is a reading aid, not a replacement for the source. I check an equation, a figure and a paragraph against the original before relying on an import. Imports and saved work need an account, and conversion/AI use external services. New imports default to Shared, so choose Only me for private material.

Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/onlyideas/id6816392935?platform=mac

If you read papers in a second language, I’d be interested in whether you prefer switching views or having the translation directly below each paragraph.

value.title: I built a Mac paper reader that keeps the original, translation and passage-level questions together

claim_boundaries: Mac release is not proof of iOS or Android approval.
Free download does not promise unlimited conversion or AI usage.
Imports and AI requests use external services; no blanket offline or private-default claim.
Publication and queues are not users, customers or money.
